findingDetails.title: Startup claim is emitted under an inferred, demonstrably wrong hook event name
findingDetails.scopeProof: payloadEventName is the only event-naming path for both emits; MISSING_EVENT_POLICIES.claude=infer claims the no-event class
findingDetails.case: A Claude SessionStart payload with source=startup and no hook_event_name is emitted under PostToolUse, so the fresh session never receives the claim instructions.

findingDetails.title: recordGoalPacket rewrites note frontmatter with no open-status guard
findingDetails.scopeProof: claimHandoff, completeHandoff and supersedeClaimed all re-check status under withAppendLock; recordGoalPacket is the only frontmatter writer that does not
findingDetails.case: The receiver claims the note between prepare pre-check and the goal_packet write; the write edits the now-claimed note and re-pins it 0600.

findingDetails.title: Active goal with no condition text is reported as a packet-resolution failure
findingDetails.scopeProof: headline is consumed only at 624, 633 and 643; all three treat empty as no proof, so only the message at 645-647 misdescribes it
findingDetails.case: A goal_status attachment with met=false and no condition string yields headline="", so the operator is told the goal names no packet instead of that no goal text was found.

findingDetails.title: OpenCode goal record layout is re-derived instead of using the shared resolver
findingDetails.scopeProof: goal-core readGoalRecord plus opencode-goal sessionKeyForSession/goalPathForSession plus this branch are three copies of one on-disk contract
findingDetails.case: The plugin renames its per-session goal file or adds the legacy-filename migration the shared resolver models; the OpenCode carry then silently resolves no packet.

noveltyJustification: First iteration on this session: all four findings are new, no prior registry entries existed to refine.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 18 scope files, two runtimes and a cross-module on-disk contract; correctness pass across the resolution state machine

targetSelection.selectionReason: Goal resolver, prepare output, handoff note seed and the Claude start claim are produced and consumed by these six files

searchLedger.hypothesis: The startup claim can be emitted under an event name that does not match the hook that fired
searchLedger.invariant: An emitted hook envelope must name the event the hook was invoked for

searchActions.result: startup branch emits via payloadEventName, which has no SessionStart branch

searchLedger.rationale: Reach is the no-hook_event_name class the module itself claims to support

searchLedger.hypothesis: A frontmatter writer can mutate a note another session already claimed
searchLedger.invariant: A note mutation must refuse a note whose status it does not own

searchActions.result: three sibling mutators guard status; recordGoalPacket does not

searchLedger.rationale: Confirmed by contrast with every sibling mutator under the same lock

searchLedger.hypothesis: A failure reason can blame the packet when the goal text was never readable
searchLedger.invariant: A refusal reason must name the condition that actually failed

searchActions.result: empty headline flows to the packet-miss reason

searchLedger.hypothesis: The OpenCode goal record layout is duplicated between the plugin and the relaunch reader
searchLedger.invariant: One on-disk contract should have one resolver

searchActions.result: three derivations of the same per-session path

searchLedger.rationale: Silent failure mode because the read is caught and degrades to no packet

searchLedger.hypothesis: A stale or malformed armed record can be relaunched past the hop or age limit
searchLedger.invariant: hop and age limits fail closed on non-numeric or future-dated fields

searchActions.result: hops read without coercion; backward clock treated as stale

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of every branch

searchLedger.hypothesis: A crafted claim seed can smuggle a packet path or shell metacharacters
searchLedger.invariant: A seed path must be absolute, single-line and free of shell breaks

searchActions.result: spec folder pattern anchored; path escaping covers \"$` and !

searchLedger.rationale: Seed parsing and escaping both reject the class
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: validated path shape and escaping inspected
